title: Enriching ACP wire notifications before session log persistence
answers: Why must ACP wire notifications be enriched before calling logWriter.appendNotification?
Why does reloading a thread lose the trace ID on agent turns?
Where are ACP wire messages stamped with run trace IDs?
body:
ACP wire notifications must be enriched with turn metadata (such as stamping traceId via products/desktop/packages/agent/src/acp-extensions.ts:withTurnTraceId) before being written to logWriter.appendNotification.
Enforced in: products/desktop/packages/agent/src/adapters/acp-connection.ts:installWireTaps
What breaks if skipped: Thread reloading reads stored events from the session log rather than the broadcast stream; persisting unstamped wire events causes reloaded threads to lose the turn trace ID.
applies: PostHog desktop ACP connection wiretap handling and session log writing.
